messages:
Aisha (CEO): Leaving this thread for quick follow-ups from today's all-hands about positioning, the roadmap, and competitor Qs. Post short Qs and I'll reply.
Dev (eng): Quick: should reps ever bring up quantization in discovery calls, or keep it buried?
Aisha (CEO): Keep it high level in discovery. Say: "we use model quantization and smart batching to lower unit costs without sacrificing quality" only if the buyer digs into cost mechanics.
Nora (prod): For the roadmap: do we lock the quarter to runtime perf work or balance with product features like reranking?
Tom (VP Product): Prioritize runtime perf for the top model families this quarter (latency + quant stability). Feature work (reranking, eval UX) is next quarter once perf is stable.
Liam (sales): Need a two-line rebuttal for "we can just host models ourselves" that isn't confrontational.
Aisha (CEO): Two-line: "Self-hosting looks simple until you hit tail latency, KV cache correctness, and ongoing ops. We provide those primitives as a product so your team can ship features, not infra."
Dev (eng): Any specific SLO we should put in customer proposals as an example?
Tom (VP Product): Use this template: `99th pct latency < 200ms` for Dedicated-XL on typical gen workloads and `availability >= 99.9%` under SLA. Tailor when you have measured numbers.
Liam (sales): Thanks  will wait for the battlecard.
slides-bot: Recording and slides uploaded: https://internal.redwood.example/all-hands/3076543210 (auto) :white_check_mark:
Aisha (CEO): I'll publish a short battlecard and the SLO one-pager here by EOD. Closing thread
Aisha
